items.label: PAINTED GYP BOARD CEILING (suspended GWB assembly per detail 02/A120) - height in three-way disagreement: A510.2 8'-0" / A521 RCP 8'-6" / A120 tag 12'-3 3/8"
items.instanceNote: ⚑ Three architectural readings: A510.2 tags Unisex 027 at 8'-0"; A521's RCP tags the same room (as UNISEX 121) at 8'-6"; A120 prints 12'-3 3/8" over painted-gyp stipple - A120's own flag calls that implausible for a single-occupant restroom (12'-3 3/8" is the floor-to-underside dimension used for open-to-structure rooms elsewhere on that sheet) and says verify against the enlarged plan / RFI. The SYSTEM (painted gyp) is consistent on the A120 hatch and the A521 RCP legend; only the height is contested. The draft's PT-07 flag covers only the 8'-0" vs 8'-6" pair - it does not mention A120. Confirm before grid, sprinkler drops or wallcovering height.
